Name: Jehiel, Son of Laadan
Summary: Chief son of Laadan, with Zetham and Joel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:8; 1 Chronicles 26:21: Chief son of Laadan, with Zetham and Joel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
